id: title:Gilbert09:route hogland agent through the llm gateway not direct bedrock

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a parameter to the Hogland sandbox agent runtime environment builder, allowing Hogland sandboxes to opt out of direct Bedrock access and route requests through PostHog's LLM gateway.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F4.H2 demonstrates a substantive, bounded change: the addition of an `unset_bedrock` parameter to the `build_agent_runtime_env_prefix` function. This allows Hogland sandboxes to opt out of direct Bedrock access, routing requests through PostHog's LLM gateway instead. This is a clear implementation of a capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the HoglandSandbox class, the HoglandSandbox class definition, or the SandboxBase class, so the actual assignment of the disable_direct_bedrock attribute and its usage cannot be verified. The chunk also does not include the implementation of the build_agent_runtime_env_prefix function, so the actual construction of the unset flags, }
